reviews.frank_statement: Parser/render/context transformations that corrupt downstream structured semantics are inherited FRANK regression risks; ClayCode should preserve explicit semantic/authority distinctions.
reviews.counterhypothesis: A permissive prose-like ClayCode grammar with arbitrary identifier infix operators can remain deterministic and cheaper to author without damaging canonical roundtrip or semantic hashes.
reviews.falsifier: A generic-infix parser over the complete G9 corpus demonstrates unambiguous ASTs, stable canonical hashes, lower repair cost and no authority/meaning collisions under mutation/fuzz tests.
independent_checks: WebAssembly Component Model WIT specification uses explicit lexical token classes, reserved keywords/operators and a pseudo-formal grammar rather than arbitrary prose infix syntax: https://github.com/WebAssembly/component-model/blob/main/design/mvp/WIT.md
adversarial_checks: The local proxy intentionally kept arbitrary IDENT-as-infix disabled and tested exact prose-like CURRENT G9 counterexamples; they fail closed rather than being guessed.
reviews.reason: Independent language-interface practice supports explicit lexical/grammar boundaries, while this run does not yet prove the exact final ClayCode grammar. Strict normalization is therefore a candidate, not promotion.

reviews.frank_statement: ClayCode BASE must express versioned visual classifier/prototype state, trusted example provenance, calibrated open-set outcomes, candidate promotion/rollback and resource/replay semantics.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Existing generic records/deltas/provenance/effect constructs are insufficient for a real adaptive visual learner and require a new semantic primitive.
reviews.falsifier: Compile and execute an MVC state/update/promotion/rollback program with current frozen semantics; any irreducible escape hatch or unrepresentable transition falsifies sufficiency.
adversarial_checks: No MVC implementation was compiled in this run; no representability claim is upgraded from shared FRANK/Harness ancestry alone.
reviews.reason: The current run tested parser-surface compatibility only. Adaptive visual learner representability remains an executable application question.
